name: The Purple Ones
summary: Clubtoe asks you to stop Twilight's Hammer rituals in Sunnyglade. The rites empower some ogres and kill others.

sections.title: Rites in Sunnyglade
sections.body: In Sunnyglade, Clubtoe sends you against Twilight Ritualists and Empowered Brutes. A dead ogre appears to be one of the friends Clubtoe sought. The rituals strengthen some members and kill more, so Clubtoe wants the ritualists and their creations stopped before they spread.

faq.answer: Clubtoe is the one asking you to stop the Twilight Ritualists in Sunnyglade.

faq.q: What are the Purple Ones doing?
aliases: what are the purple ones doing
faq.answer: The Twilight Ritualists perform rites on their members. Some are empowered, while more are killed.

faq.q: Why does Clubtoe want the rituals stopped?
faq.answer: Clubtoe fears the ritualists and their monstrosities will spread.
A dead ogre appears to be one of the friends Clubtoe was searching for.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Purple Ones
